episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Lucy arrives in Tangier, 1955, one of the last outposts of colonial decadence, where she discovers a world of sexual possibilities and political strife.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Lucy gets herself an invitation to an exclusive wrap party, which she attends with Adham. Later, she is invited to lunch with the Secretary without her husband.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Hugo struggles with unfinished business that Lucy's father asked him to take care of. Adham finds his royal bearing is of little help in the Interzone.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Lucy decamps to the home of the Contessa Mandrax where she is consoled by the Contessa and Lili. Meanwhile, Cherifa returns to Tangier.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Lucy meets Bill, who claims to be an artist but is actually an undercover agent for the CIA. Meanwhile, Cherifa falls into the Secretary's trap.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Lucy decides to collaborate with the CIA in entrapping her father and is forced to work with Cherifa in order to free herself.
